title: 06 THREE-MICROPHONE AUDIO INPUT
purpose: Three digital MEMS microphones (ICS-43434) with 24-bit I2S output. Mic 1 and Mic 2 share I2S_MIC_SD1 with L/R select, Mic 3 is on I2S_MIC_SD2. All microphones share common I2S_MIC_CLK and I2S_MIC_WS clock lines.

parts.role: Digital MEMS Microphone 1 (Left Channel on SD1)
Digital MEMS Microphone 2 (Right Channel on SD1)
Digital MEMS Microphone 3 (Left Channel on SD2)

qa.formula: MIC1: LR=GND (Left), MIC2: LR=VDD (Right), MIC3: LR=GND (Left on SD2)
qa.result: Enables TDM/Stereo pair on SD1 line while MIC3 provides dedicated reference/beamforming channel on SD2.

qa.formula: C_dec = 0.1 uF placed close to each VDD pin
qa.result: Meets recommendation of 0.1uF ceramic bypass to suppress clock feedthrough and supply ripple.
